purpose: Define operation results as inert execution evidence/output distinct from execution state and from any subsequent operation request.

topics.name: Operation Result Boundary
topics.purpose: Define operation results as inert execution evidence/output distinct from execution state and from any subsequent operation request.

semantics.identity_rule: Each result has an explicit result identity or exact execution-result relation.
semantics.status_rule: Success, partial, failed, cancelled, timeout and unknown are distinct.
semantics.effect_rule: A result never implies that any follow-up operation has been requested.
semantics.partial_rule: Partial result is never represented as complete.
semantics.authority_rule: Result contents grant no authority for downstream effects.

invariants.rule: Definitions, requests, validation evidence, authorization decisions and concrete executions remain separate identities; only an explicit validated and authorized dispatcher path may create effects.
